activity.role: Author of One Day in the Life of Ivan Denisovich published in Soviet literary journal Novy Mir
activity.notes: The novella was published in the November 1962 issue of the Soviet journal Novy Mir. Its fictional prison-camp setting is not the author's Moscow residence and must not be represented as a verified Place. The 1962 point records publication rather than an invented literary tenure or political office.
